name: Abilene expansion (Microsoft)
status_note: Two buildings next to Stargate Abilene, first planned for OpenAI/Oracle; Microsoft took them after Oracle and OpenAI dropped the expansion (Bloomberg, Mar 2026). Epoch projects 672 MW IT by late 2027.

construction_start.note: Epoch satellite: land clearing for Buildings 1–2 begins 2 Nov 2025.

sources.title: Crusoe Abilene Expansion – AI data center directory
Oracle and OpenAI end plans to expand flagship data center
